messages:
Ava: quick launch-day asset sprint for Serving Wins webinar (May 28). Need: hero slide 1920x1080, benchmark explainer card (PNG+SVG), editable slide master, 3 socials (square, story, wide), email header, SDR leave-behind PDF. Small: export PNG@2x + SVG, include alt text. Deadline: Tue noon first pass. @Ravi @June
Ravi: got it. Do we show competitor names or anonymize? need CSV to plot exact points.
Ava: anonymize into two clusters, highlight 'recommended config' callout. CSV in analytics; granting view to design.
June: brand rules: primary color Redwood Blue; use Ink for type. No gradients on charts. Stacked logo for hero, horizontal on footer. I'll paste swatches in Figma.
Carmen: hero copy options:
- "Serving Wins: Faster inference, lower cost."
- "Ship reliable LLM features with predictable latency."
Pick first for hero.
Eli: tracking/UTM template: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=servingwins_may28. HubSpot mapping: hs_source="Webinar: Serving Wins", hs_campaign="servingwins_may28", hs_tags="webinar_servingwins". I will create form embed.
Legal: need provenance for numbers (CSV + API run IDs) before approving any comparative language.
figma-bot: Figma file created and shared: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/SERVING_WINS - pages: Hero, Benchmark, Socials, OnePager.
Ravi: will deliver 3 hero directions (clean data, typographic, photo) + benchmark card variants Tue 11am. Exports: PNG@2x, SVG, PDF for one-pager. Alt text in Figma descriptions.
Ava: great. Please name files: servingwins_<asset>_<size>_v1.png. Tag sheet row 'approved_for_publish' after Legal sign-off.
Legal: will review by Tue 3pm once CSV and API logs attached. No absolute % claims without source note.
Ava: thanks team :thumbsup:
notes: Launch asset sprint thread with UTMs, HubSpot mapping, legal provenance request, and Figma link.
